name: rpg
description: Claude Code plugin that runs development as an RPG. You are the Summoner, Claude is the Daemon you call, bound by a pact. /rpg:summon surveys a repository; /rpg:quest scries the code, casts the change with a commit per step, holds the trial (lint, tests, review, security), writes the pull request and merges on your word; /rpg:questline cuts a big goal into quests; /rpg:sidequest keeps what turns up on the way; /rpg:journal shows where things stand; /rpg:evocation lays out roads when you are stuck. Subagent forks take independent parts, a guard hook refuses force pushes, every fact carries its source, and the game never reaches your code, docs or pull requests.
